hooks.command: bash -c 'filepath=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path"); filename=$(basename "$filepath"); if [[ "$filename" == .env ]] || [[ "$filename" == .env.local ]]; then if [ -f "$filepath" ]; then tmpfile=$(mktemp); sed -E "s/^([^#=][^=]*)=.*/\1=***MASKED***/" "$filepath" > "$tmpfile"; jq -n --arg tmpfile "$tmpfile" "{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: \"PreToolUse\", updatedInput: {file_path: \$tmpfile}}, systemMessage: \"Masking secrets - reading masked version instead\"}" 2>/dev/null || echo "{\"continue\": true}"; else echo "{\"continue\": true}"; fi; else echo "{\"continue\": true}"; fi'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for sensitive files to mask...
